title: Output Format Biases in the Evaluation of Large Language Models for Code Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Empirical analysis comparing execution-based metrics (Computational Accuracy) and text-oriented metrics (BLEU, CodeBLEU) on LLM-generated code translations before and after applying prompt engineering and regular expressions to extract pure source code from mixed-format outputs (e.g., code mixed with natural language explanations or markdown).
